title: Grateful Dead Live at Youth Opportunities Center on 1966-02-12

ai_review.summary: Fair‑quality soundboard capture of a historic 1966 Acid Test jam – Pigpen’s wild spoken pieces shine while the musical content divides listeners.
ai_review.review: The recording is an early soundboard (SBD) from February 1966 that documents a chaotic Acid Test session rather than a conventional concert. Reviewers rave about Pigpen’s raw vocal energy and the historic “Foolish → Walkin’ Blues → Day Job” jam, but many note the lack of Jerry Garcia’s guitar and describe the audio as noisy or more like an ambient field recording.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating is 3.8 across ten reviews; strong praise for Pigpen and historical value offset by frequent criticism of musical thinness and modest sound quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners describe the tape as noisy, likening it to a zoo‑like field recording; no major dropouts mentioned but fidelity is primitive by modern standards.

show_quality.setlist_flow: An experimental Acid Test set with spoken‑word raps, Pigpen’s improvisations and a few loose jam fragments; Jerry Garcia is absent, giving the session an uneven musical flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Not present in the music – several reviewers note “No Jerry in the music.”
band_member_comments.Bob: Absent from vocal collaborations that some fans wished for (e.g., pig, Brent and Bobby together).
band_member_comments.Drums: Briefly mentioned when a drum kick prompts Pigpen’s rap; no specific praise or criticism.
